# Orders of the real comparison

The three self-brew orders that `node scripts/tasting-compare.ts --real` tastes at their brewed heads ([ADR 0332](../../../../docs/adr/0332-tasting-compare-real-re-tastes-brewed-heads-and-writes-blinded-lists.md), #879).
Each `<order>.md` is that issue's title on its first line and its body as it stood when the order brewed, unchanged, with no comment.
`867-comment.md` is the one comment a maintainer wrote on an order before it brewed, in its exact words and no later one: the setup `867-comments` tastes #867 with it on the issue, and `867-reads` without it ([ADR 0333](../../../../docs/adr/0333-a-brewer-s-order-holds-the-maintainers-comments.md)).
The key to score the runs against is in #879, and stays out of the repository: a Taster reads this repository.
